name: Odoo
summary: Odoo Community 20 with Caddy and PostgreSQL. Optional domain with HTTPS.
getting_started: Open your server address and sign in with the email and password shown once. The login and the master password are also stored on the server in /root/.beltoft-app/credentials.json. The master password protects database management; Odoo's database manager is turned off for safety, so it is only needed if you turn it on again in /opt/odoo/config/odoo.conf. Add a domain for HTTPS before real use; without a domain the address is not encrypted. Outgoing mail on port 25 is blocked on all servers; use an SMTP service on port 587 or 465 in Odoo's outgoing mail server settings. Backups are your job: because the database manager is off, back up the database with docker compose exec postgres pg_dump from /opt/odoo, and copy the filestore volume (docker volume odoo_odoo-data). Updates are manual: pull a newer image of the same major version and restart. This is Odoo Community, licensed under the LGPL-3.0; Enterprise apps need an Odoo subscription. The smallest plan runs Odoo for one or two users; for more users or several apps, choose 2 cores and 4 GB of memory or more.
